summary.shortDescription: A compact Billet Box integrated mod whose Rev. 3a revision introduced the first production anodized run in May 2014.
summary.description: Billet Box describes the Rev. 3a as a revised production Billet Box with a bead-blasted, bright-dipped anodized aluminum finish. The manufacturer history page places its introduction in May 2014 and distinguishes it from the later Rev. 4 redesign.

sources.title: The Billet Box history and current product page
sources.limitations: The manufacturer history page is retrospective and describes the Rev. 3a launch and later revisions on one page.
